title: Advancing Quantization for R&R Models with Microscaling Formats
abstract: arXiv:2611.17501v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommendation and Ranking (R&R) models, particularly in digital advertising, require massive inference throughput but exhibit extreme sensitivity to precision loss. Unlike Large Language Models (LLMs) that frequently tolerate quantization-induced accuracy drops of 1% or more, production-grade R&R models enforce a stringent launch bar: model quality must remain within a 0.01% Normalized Entropy (NE) margin relative to the baseline, which commonly uses FP16 or FP32. This tight constraint has historically hindered the adoption of aggressive quantization in this domain. In this paper, we present an empirical evaluation of both MXFP8 and the 6-bit MXFP6 format for industrial-scale R&R inference on the AMD MI350X architecture. translated_title: 基于微缩放格式推进推荐与排序模型的量化
translated_abstract: 推荐与排序（R&R）模型，尤其在数字广告领域，需要极高的推理吞吐量，同时对精度损失表现出极端的敏感性。与大语言模型（LLM）不同——后者通常能容忍1%或更高的量化导致的精度下降——生产级R&R模型执行严格的上线标准：模型质量必须保持在相对于基线（通常使用FP16或FP32）0.01%归一化熵（NE）的误差范围内。这一严苛的约束历来阻碍了激进量化技术在该领域的采用。本文针对AMD MI350X架构上的工业规模R&R推理，对MXFP8和6位MXFP6格式进行了实证评估。据我们所知，这是在R&R和LLM领域中首篇报告原生MXFP6 GEMM带来显著加速的论文，该方法同时对权重和激活进行量化，并直接在6位元素上进行计算。
tldr: 本文首次报告了原生MXFP6 GEMM（同时量化权重和激活）在AMD MI350X上为工业规模推荐与排序模型推理带来显著加速，同时满足相对基线仅0.01%归一化熵偏差的严苛精度要求。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first, across both R&R and LLM domains, to report significant speedups from native MXFP6 GEMMs that quantize both weights and activations, while meeting the stringent 0.01% Normalized Entropy accuracy margin for industrial-scale R&R inference on AMD MI350X.
